title: AffectAnnotation
description: Affect classification result for a text event with valence, arousal, policy band, and confidence scores. Reference: ADR-0012a (k003a)

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the event being classified

space_id.description: Space/household identifier where the event occurred

confidence.description: Classification confidence score: 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (high confidence)

band.description: Policy band classification for safety/privacy control

band_reasons.description: Human-readable reasons for the band classification (maps to policy rule IDs)

model_version.description: Affect model version used for classification (e.g., 'tier0_v1.0', 'tier1_v1.0')

computed_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when classification was computed
